steps.title: Calculate the discount amount
steps.change: Every product must remain in the output.
steps.added_sql:
select 
ProductID,
Product,
 Market_Price,
Sale_Price,
(
case
when Market_Price is null or Market_Price =0 then Null
else (Market_Price - Sale_Price)
end 
) as discount_amount
from Products
order by ProductID

steps.title: Calculate the percentage
steps.change: Real-valued division preserves fractional percentages before rounding.
steps.sql:
select 
ProductID,
Product,
 Market_Price,
Sale_Price,
(
case
when Market_Price is null or Market_Price =0 then Null
else (Market_Price - Sale_Price)
end 
) as discount_amount,
(
case
when Market_Price is null or Market_Price =0 then Null
else round((  ((Market_Price - Sale_Price)*100.0/ Market_Price)),2)
end 
) 

 as discount_pct
from Products
order by ProductID

steps.title: Sort the result
steps.change: The largest measured discounts belong first.
